id: 27_Emergency Preparedness, Safety measures in microbiology labs, laboratory microbi
title: 微生物实验室的应急准备
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/27_Emergency Preparedness, Safety measures in microbiology labs, laboratory microbi.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/27_Emergency Preparedness, Safety measures in microbiology labs, laboratory microbi/src.py

points.K1: 应急准备：事前备好，事发不慌
points.K3: 人人知道急救箱在哪、怎么用
points.K6: 事故和险兆，都要报告调查
points.S1: 洗眼器和喷淋：知道在哪，定期查
points.S2: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应
points.S3: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，旁边墙上挂着急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway next to a wall-mounted first aid kit and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到应急准备这一课。
overlay: 微生物实验室的应急准备

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现急救箱、电话、记录本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a first aid kit, a telephone and a notebook.
shots.narration: 三件事：急救箱、应急电话、事故报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰拔开封口膜时被培养皿边缘划破手指，愣住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gets a small cut on his gloved finger from a cracked culture dish lid and freezes.
shots.narration: 阿杰的手指被破裂的培养皿划了一下。

shots.scene: 阿杰慌张地四处找东西，打开几个抽屉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks around in panic, opening several drawers.
shots.narration: 急救箱在哪？该找谁？他全不知道。

shots.scene: 小研快步走来，指向墙上的急救箱和电话表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and points to a wall-mounted first aid kit and a blank phone list poster.
shots.narration: 小研说：这些，进实验室第一天就该知道。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 应急准备，要在事故之前做好。

shots.section_title: 应急准备：事前备好，事发不慌
shots.scene: 日历上事故前的日子被圈出，旁边打勾的清单
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with days before an accident icon circled, next to a checklist with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 事故来时没有时间准备。
overlay: 应急准备：事前备好，事发不慌

shots.section_title: 应急准备：事前备好，事发不慌
shots.scene: 王老师在空白应急清单上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks items on a blank emergency checklist in the lab.
shots.narration: 所以平时就要备好物资、记住流程。

shots.scene: 打开的急救箱，里面整齐摆着纱布、创可贴、消毒用品图标
shots.prompt_en: An open first aid kit with neatly arranged gauze, bandages and antiseptic wipes, all unlabeled. No people.
shots.narration: 急救箱要备齐常用物品。

shots.scene: 急救箱挂在门边显眼处，前面没有遮挡
shots.prompt_en: A first aid kit mounted at eye level by the door with a clear path in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 放在显眼、伸手就拿得到的地方。

shots.scene: 被纸箱挡住的急救箱被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A first aid kit blocked by stacked boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面别堆东西，也别上锁。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白清单补充急救箱，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student restocks the first aid kit using a blank checklist, a calendar icon beside her.
shots.narration: 专人管理，用了就补，过期就换。

shots.section_title: 人人知道急救箱在哪、怎么用
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰走到急救箱前，打开指给他看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to the first aid kit and opens it to show him.
shots.narration: 每个人都要知道急救箱在哪。
overlay: 人人知道急救箱在哪、怎么用

shots.section_title: 人人知道急救箱在哪、怎么用
shots.scene: 阿杰用纱布按压包扎伤口图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices applying a bandage to a finger on a training hand model.
shots.narration: 还要会用：怎么清洗，怎么包扎。

shots.section_title: 人人知道急救箱在哪、怎么用
shots.scene: 急救箱只用于小伤，大伤指向120
shots.prompt_en: A first aid kit icon for a small cut, and an arrow from a serious injury icon to an ambulance icon with 120. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得重，别硬撑，马上拨打120。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白电话表，旁边火警和救护车图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank phone list poster on the wall beside the lab phone, with fire and ambulance icons. No people.
shots.narration: 应急电话，要贴在显眼的地方。

shots.scene: 火焰图标连到119，救护车图标连到120
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon linked to 119 and an ambulance icon linked to 120. No people.

shots.scene: 电话表上几个空白人像框和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank phone list showing several empty portrait frames, each with a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有负责人、学院、保卫处的电话。

shots.scene: 箭头链：实验室、学院、学校三个楼图标
shots.prompt_en: A chain of arrows linking three building icons from small to large. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，按程序逐级报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨电话给老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls the older man on the lab phone.
shots.narration: 先报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，再往上的箭头指向学院和学校
shots.prompt_en: The older man makes a phone call; arrows point upward to a college icon and a campus security icon.
shots.narration: 负责人报学院和保卫处、生物安全管理部门。

shots.scene: 隐瞒的嘴被拉链封住图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a zipped mouth hiding an accident, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不隐瞒，不拖延。

shots.section_title: 事故和险兆，都要报告调查
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白事故报告单上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank incident report form.
shots.narration: 事故要记录，要调查原因。
overlay: 事故和险兆，都要报告调查

shots.section_title: 事故和险兆，都要报告调查
shots.scene: 差点掉落的培养皿被接住，旁边感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish almost slipping off a bench edge is caught in time, with an exclamation mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 差点出事的险兆，也要报告。

shots.section_title: 事故和险兆，都要报告调查
shots.scene: 王老师和老周对着报告单讨论，放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man discuss the blank report with a magnifying glass icon above.
shots.narration: 查清原因，不是为了追责。

shots.scene: 报告单变成新版规程，循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form turns into a new version of a procedure binder with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 从报告里找改进的地方。

shots.scene: 老周把破损培养皿换成新盒子，贴上新规程
shots.prompt_en: The older man replaces a box of cracked dishes and posts a revised blank procedure sheet on the wall.
shots.narration: 改规程、换物品，防止再发生。

shots.scene: 组会上小研分享案例，大家点头
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting, the female graduate student shares a case on a blank screen; other students nod.
shots.narration: 把教训告诉大家。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：知道在哪，定期查
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和紧急喷淋标志并排亮起
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign and an emergency shower sign light up side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 除了急救箱，还要知道洗眼器和喷淋。
overlay: 洗眼器和喷淋：知道在哪，定期查

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：知道在哪，定期查
shots.scene: 通往洗眼器的路上堆着杂物被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The path to an eyewash station blocked by boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通道保持畅通，随时能用。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋：知道在哪，定期查
shots.scene: 老李打开洗眼器放水检查，旁边记录表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer runs water through an eyewash station and marks a blank inspection sheet.
shots.narration: 定期放水检查，并做记录。

shots.section_title: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应
shots.scene: 小研拿着电话，旁边地点、事件、人员三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a phone; three icons float beside her: a map pin, a warning triangle and a person icon.
shots.narration: 打119、120，先说清地点。
overlay: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应

shots.section_title: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应
shots.scene: 楼号、房间号图标，旁边伤员图标
shots.prompt_en: A building icon with a blank room plate, next to an injured person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再说发生了什么、有几人受伤。

shots.section_title: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应
shots.scene: 阿杰站在楼门口挥手迎接救护车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits at the building entrance and waves to guide an arriving ambulance.
shots.narration: 派人到楼门口接应。

shots.section_title: 报警说清地点情况，派人接应
shots.scene: 小研把空白说明书和样本信息卡递给医护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank information card to a paramedic icon.
shots.narration: 告诉医生接触了什么材料。

shots.section_title: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理
shots.scene: 敞开台面上培养瓶打翻，周围飘起小飞沫
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask tips over on an open bench; tiny droplets float in the air around it. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜外打翻了菌液怎么办？
overlay: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理

shots.section_title: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理
shots.scene: 小研招呼大家离开房间，关上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls everyone out of the room and closes the door.
shots.narration: 先提醒旁人，离开房间，关门。

shots.section_title: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理
shots.scene: 门上挂暂停进入的图标，旁边计时器
shots.prompt_en: A do-not-enter icon hanging on the closed lab door, with a timer next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 门口提示，等气溶胶沉降。

shots.section_title: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理
shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man by phone outside the lab.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，再按规程处理。

shots.section_title: 柜外洒了：先撤离，再处理
shots.scene: 小研穿好防护，手拿空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in lab coat, gloves, goggles and a mask, holds a blank spill procedure sheet at the door.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，按规程消毒清理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在急救箱、电话表、洗眼器前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a first aid kit, a blank phone list and an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 急救箱、洗眼器，知道在哪会用。

shots.scene: 119、120图标和逐级报告箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons for 119 and 120 and a chain of arrows through three building icons. No people.
shots.narration: 119、120，逐级报告不隐瞒。

shots.scene: 报告单变成新规程的循环图
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow from a blank report form to a new procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 险兆也要报，用报告改进规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手指包扎好，在空白报告单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, his finger bandaged, signs a blank incident report form.
shots.narration: 阿杰包扎好伤口，也交了报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在急救箱旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside the first aid kit.
shots.narration: 有备无患，下次见！
